# `customer_bill_document`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

The PDF of an issued bill, rendered by the billing run in the bill's issue transaction and served at customerBill/{id}/document.pdf. Immutable: later name, address or settlement changes never rewrite it. Bills issued before migration 0086 have none.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `customer_bill_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `pdf` | `bytea` | no |  | The PDF document (application/pdf). |
| `sha256` | `text` | no |  | Lowercase hex SHA-256 of pdf. |
| `rendered_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | When it was rendered: the running billing attempt's started_at, like the bill's issue. |
